title: Latency heatmap reconciler and log sampler orchestrator
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Purpose: produce a reconciled latency heatmap derived from traces and metrics, and deploy an orchestrated log-sampler that dynamically adjusts sampling based on heatmap-derived signal and anomaly scores. Goal is to reduce noisy paging, lower log ingestion costs during steady-state, and improve burn-rate alert precision by aligning alerts to trace-backed latency slices.

Scope:
- Ingest trace spans and summarize p50/p90/p99 latency distributions per route/service into a heatmap index (time x percentile x route).
- Cross-correlate metrics-derived histograms with trace samples to detect sampling bias and apply correction factors.
- Build a Log Sampler Orchestrator that: (a) temporarily increases log sampling for routes/hosts where heatmap deviation + anomaly score exceed threshold, (b) reduces sampling for low-variance/low-impact slices to save cost, (c) emits sampling metadata to downstream pipelines for accurate rate-normalization.
- Add dashboarding components: latency heatmap widget, sample-rate timeline, simulated burn-rate overlay, and an anomaly breakpoint inspector.
- Integrate a pre-burn simulator that replays recent traffic patterns against current sampling and alert rules to estimate burn-rate sensitivity before rollout.

Deliverables:
- Heatmap indexer service and schema (metrics + trace joiner).
- Log Sampler Orchestrator (k8s deployment + CRD) with runtime policy rules.
- Grafana dashboard and a set of alert rule changes (burn-rate thresholds tuned to reconciled heatmap).
- Runbook describing canary plan, rollback safety checks, and key SLI/SLO guardrails.

Links:
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Latency+Heatmap+Reconciler
- Design notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_heatmap_design
- PR (proto indexer): https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/2146
- Dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/heatmaps/latency-reconciler-staging

Risks and mitigation:
- Sampling oscillation: add hysteresis in policy engine and minimum/maximum sample caps.
- Alert regressions (false positive burn-rate trips): pre-burn simulation + shadowing new burn-rate rules for 48h before enforcement.
- Cost blowouts during incident: emergency global throttle that forces sampler to fixed low-rate and routes full payloads to archival storage for later enrichment.
comments: 2026-02-26 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes attached to Confluence. Decided initial heatmap bucketization: 1m windows x 50ms bins for p50/p90/p99. Riley to prototype indexer.

2026-03-02 - Riley Chen: Prototype indexer committed (PR #2146). Early join shows mismatch in p99 for /chat route due to trace sampling bias — added correction factor by weight. Needs validation against metrics histogram service.

2026-03-05 - Nikhil Rao (observability): Reviewed prototype. Asked for clear SLI definitions and an interface for exporting normalized sample weights to the ingestion pipeline. Added dependency on metrics histogram schema update (ENG-987654).

2026-03-08 - Riley Chen: Implemented sampler policy CRD v1alpha with hysteresis and emergency_ttl. Deployed to staging; sampler logs show expected up/down adjustments when synthetic anomalies injected.

2026-03-10 - Sarah Li (oncall): Ran pre-burn simulation with canary config; simulated burn-rate reduced by ~22% with no SLO degradation for p90. Recommended additional guard: shadow new burn-rate alerts for 72h.

2026-03-12 - Product (Marcus Boyd): Approved rollout plan pending one performance regression fix: high-cardinality heatmap keys caused memory spikes in indexer when tagging by host+route. Riley to add cardinality limiter and LRU eviction.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for joiner/correction logic and weight normalization. 2) End-to-end staging test: replay 2h of production trace+metric data and validate heatmap against baseline metric histograms. 3) Load test indexer to 2x current cardinality and verify memory bounds. 4) Shadow burn-rate alerts for 72h and compare alert delta. 5) Canary rollout to 10% of requests with rollback flag if error-rate or p99 increases > 10%.
rollout_steps: - Merge indexer + sampler PRs. - Deploy indexer to staging, validate against metrics histograms. - Deploy sampler in shadow mode, run 72h. - Enable simulated burn-rate overlay and run pre-burn simulation. - Canary enable sampler policies at 10% traffic for 24h. - Gradual ramp to 50% with monitoring runbook active. - Full rollout with emergency_ttl and global throttle configured.
observability_goals: - Reduce noisy burn-rate driven paging by 30% within 4 weeks. - Lower log ingestion cost for steady-state traffic by 20% while preserving SLOs. - Improve time-to-detect true p99 regressions by providing trace-backed heatmap slices enabling triage in <10min.
followups: Instrumenting sample-rate metadata into long-term storage for retrospective analysis
